request.description: Targeted pixel-art touch-up. Preserve the exact hedgehog pose, silhouette, face, expression, green leaf, feet and base colors. Edit only the spiny back: replace dense bright single pixel flecks with fewer grouped warm brown and tan 2 to 4 pixel quill clusters, broad warm midtone, restrained highlights, clean thin dark brown outline. Keep a clearly spiky hedgehog contour. Preserve 96px framing and transparency.

Retouch this exact baby wild boar sprite. Keep its three-quarter pose, dusty-pink snout, tan back stripes, ears and clearly separated hooves. Lower the high shoulder and bulky back slightly. Make cheek and belly softly rounded like a small piglet. Add warm dark-brown midtone planes on body and forelegs, keeping the dark coat. Clean thin dark-brown outline, clustered shading, no tusks or accessories. Keep the same 96px transparent canvas.
